plugins.name: bettermemory
plugins.description: Verification-grade memory for Claude Code. Every retrieved fact carries a staleness verdict (calendar age + filesystem path drift + git commit drift) so the model knows when a stored memory has rotted before relying on it; retrievals are logged with three attribution tiers (model-explicit with claim-level excerpts, Stop-hook substring match, or auto-fallback) so a reply months later can be traced back to the load-bearing stored claim wherever it was recorded. Memories are plain markdown + YAML in ~/.claude-memory/; retrieval is opt-in per turn, with a score-gated recall hook injecting a single stored pointer on the ~2% of prompts the silent-miss probe flags; writes about you always stage for confirmation. A sibling episode tier (5 episode_* tools) gives /loop iterations and subagent handoffs a home for journal-shaped run-state the durability gate rejects. Bundles 27 MCP tools â 18 registered by default, the nine curation/power-user tools behind full_tool_surface (22 memory_* + 5 episode_*) â and a memory-discipline skill that lands the policy in the system prompt.
plugins.author: Mattias Rask
